## 1. Continuous Batching (Dynamic / Optimized Batching)

### Concept & Mechanics
Traditional static batching partitions incoming requests into fixed-size batches (e.g., batch size = 32) upon arrival, processing them to completion. If only 2 requests arrive, 30 GPU slots sit idle. **Continuous (or dynamic) batching** decouples request scheduling from execution boundaries.
